title: standardized surfaces and stock

specimens.name: Factory-painted cold-rolled steel plate
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Rectangular industrial-gray steel plate with smooth sprayed enamel, clean rolled edges and only faint non-corrosive service scuffs; no rust, orange oxidation, raw bare-metal face or heavy chipping

specimens.name: Olive-gray factory-painted steel panel
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Rectangular olive-gray factory-painted panel with uniform utilitarian coating and only a few tiny edge chips exposing clean steel; no joints, fasteners, rust, orange oxidation or distressed patina

specimens.name: Safety-yellow folded sheet-metal sample
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Broad safety-yellow rectangular sheet coupon whose large flat face clearly dominates, with exactly one narrow 90-degree return flange along one short edge; NOT an angle profile, NOT a channel, NOT a constant L-section, no second return flange, no holes or attached hardware

specimens.name: Short galvanized steel angle profile
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Short unpainted galvanized equal-leg L-section with two narrow legs of equal width, uniform thickness, zinc-spangle metallic finish and a clean factory-cut end; absolutely no yellow paint, no broad sheet face, no holes or fasteners

specimens.name: Short anodized aluminium U-channel extrusion
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Straight short U-channel extrusion with repeatable geometry, clean machined end and clean anodized aluminium finish; no attached hardware, rust, orange oxidation or painted safety color

specimens.name: Short square steel box-section
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Standardized short hollow square box-section with clearly visible square open end, clean factory cut and even gray primer; no round tube, no fasteners, rust or orange oxidation

specimens.name: Molded phenolic / early industrial-plastic spacer block
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Rectangular dark-brown to black molded phenolic spacer block with exactly one clean functional through-bore; solid molded material, no wood grain, foam core, metal inserts or transparent plastic

specimens.name: Molded neoprene vibration pad
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Thick black rectangular molded neoprene vibration pad with crisp molded edges and shallow functional ribbing across the face; flat pad, not a roll or tube, no metal inserts

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing
whole machines, complete buildings, rooms or staged scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen, substitution, or reinterpretation of one listed specimen as another
baked cast shadows, contact shadows, glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX
welds, bolts, rivets, hinges, brackets, hatches or grilles
pipes, valves, hoses, cables, connectors, gears, motors, bearings, instruments, switches or lamps
wood, glass, transparent panels, round tubes, PVC or white plastic extrusions, rolled rubber sheets, foam-core blocks or any unlisted stock class
visible rust, orange oxidation, heavy chipping, distressed patina or hand-cut scars on any specimen
photorealistic PBR material-catalog rendering, filtered 3D-render appearance or soft studio-product photography

era_contract.character: standardized factory stock, repeatable dimensions, controlled coatings, clean bends and extrusions, and early industrial polymers
required_signals: early industrial phenolic and molded rubber stock
forbidden_regressions: cream or beige flat plate replacing the safety-yellow folded sample
yellow-painted angle replacing the unpainted galvanized L-profile
rolled rubber replacing the molded neoprene pad
heavy rust or hand-cut scars as dominant cues
